ctax.heading.text: The coordination tax sits between the design and its proof.

ctax.lede.text: Gates close on evidence, traceability holds, and the design history is already audit-ready.

ctax.sr.text: Four gates of design work, each compared side by side. Today each gate is separated from its proof by coordination work: the requirement-to-result trace breaks between tools, specifications lock before supplier capability is verified, requirements pass review with no linked result, and every programme rebuilds its FMEA from scratch. On one governed record the same four gates stay connected: every input links to its result, capability is checked before the spec locks, a requirement cannot close without its verification, and catalogued failure modes carry into the next programme. The metrics keep their original units and are not plotted on a shared scale.

ctax.stagecol.text: The same four gates, paid for twice

ctax.before.note.text: Design work is fragmented by the rebuilding needed to trace, verify, and prove it.

ctax.after.note.text: Every requirement, decision, and result stays attached to the same record.

ctax.stage1.note.text: Requirements, results, and verification stay one chain.

ctax.stage2.note.text: Supplier capability verified before the gate, on the record.
